summary_ja: リテール向けエクスポージャーのEAD(オン・バランス資産項目の下限、リボルビング型の掛目、合計の下限、貸出金と預金の相殺、準用規定)を定める。
summary_en: Sets EAD for retail exposures: the on-balance-sheet floor, credit conversion factors for revolving exposures, an overall EAD floor, recognition of netting of loans and deposits, and mutatis mutandis rules.
paragraphs: The EAD for on-balance sheet asset items used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for retail exposures shall be an amount not lower than the sum of the amount by which capital would decrease if that retail exposure were written off in full, specific loan loss provisions, the partial direct write-off amount, and, where a defaulted purchased receivable was purchased at a discount, the amount of that discount (limited to that which does not require refund).

The EAD for off-balance sheet asset items used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for credit extended under revolving exposures among retail exposures shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the undrawn amount of the credit facility by an estimate of the credit conversion factor, or the estimated amount of additional drawdowns that may be made; provided, however, that for off-balance sheet asset items to which a credit conversion factor of 100% applies under Article 45, it shall be the amount obtained by multiplying that undrawn amount by 100% as the credit conversion factor, and where it does not fall under credit extended as a revolving exposure, it shall be the amount obtained by multiplying that undrawn amount by the credit conversion factor corresponding to types 1 through 6 of off-balance sheet transactions listed in the middle column of the table in paragraph (1) of that Article.

Notwithstanding the preceding two paragraphs, the total of EAD for on-balance sheet asset items and off-balance sheet asset items used in the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and in calculating expected loss for retail exposures shall be no less than the sum of the total EAD of on-balance sheet asset items and the amount obtained by multiplying by 50% the total credit equivalent amount of the off-balance sheet transactions provided in Article 45.

Where, among the off-balance sheet asset items of revolving exposures to retail, only the credit extended that has already been drawn is transferred as the underlying asset of a securitization transaction, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall estimate EAD taking into account the possibility of additional drawdowns for the entire undrawn portion corresponding to the drawn credit transferred, and calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets using that EAD.

The provisions of Articles 46 through 54 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the EAD of retail exposures. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in those provisions shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach".
An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach may take into account the effect of netting of loans and deposits in estimating the EAD of retail exposures.

The provisions of Article 59, Article 93 and Articles 106 through 108 shall apply mutatis mutandis where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach takes into account the effect of netting of loans and deposits under the preceding paragraph. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in those provisions shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach".
